Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Fixed audio quality gradually degrading while co-hosting and monitoring the on-stage DJ during a longer session - the monitoring buffer's cushion against network hiccups was thinner than it needed to be. Also fixed a rare warning/hitch where the tempo slider could briefly get a zero-width hit box right after un-minimizing the window.
